--- import BookingButton from "@/components/BookingButton.astro" import SectionHeading from "@/components/seo-local/SectionHeading.astro" import "@/styles/template.css" import type { AccentTitle, Tier } from "./types" interface Props { id?: string headingId: string keyword: string title: AccentTitle tiers: Tier[] note?: string answer?: string } const { id = "precios", headingId, keyword, title, tiers, note, answer } = Astro.props --- <section id={id} aria-labelledby={headingId}> <SectionHeading id={headingId} keyword={keyword} title={title} answer={answer} /> {Astro.slots.has("lede") && <p><slot name="lede" /></p>} {note && <p>{note}</p>} <div> { tiers.map((tier) => ( <article]}> <div> <h3>{tier.name}</h3> {tier.recommended && <span>Recomendado</span>} </div> <p>{tier.from}</p> <ul> {tier.includes.map((item) => ( <li> <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"> <path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5" /> </svg> <span>{item}</span> </li> ))} </ul> {tier.note && <p>{tier.note}</p>} <div><BookingButton label={tier.ctaLabel} /></div> </article> )) } </div> </section>
